sn12.16:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekaṃ antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn12.16:2.1: Jarāmaraṇassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti || dhammakathiko bhikkhū ti alaṃ vacanāya || || 5
sn12.16:2.2: Jarāmaraṇassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāyā paṭipanno hoti || dhammānuddhammapaṭipanno bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya || || 6
sn12.16:2.3: Jarāmaraṇassa ce bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti || diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya || || 7
sn12.16:3.11: Avijjāya ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti || dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya || 8
sn12.16:3.12: Avijjāya ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti || dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya || || 9
sn12.16:3.13: Avijjāya ce bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti || diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāyāti || ||
